forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Circular dependencies make modules impossible to reason about or test in isolation.

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: Orphan modules are usually dead code left behind by a refactor.

forbidden.name: no-deprecated-core
forbidden.comment: Deprecated Node core modules will be removed in a future runtime.

forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep
forbidden.comment: Production code must not import a devDependency — it will be absent in the deployed image.

forbidden.name: no-non-package-json
forbidden.comment: Dependency used but not declared in package.json — breaks on a clean install.

forbidden.name: mobile-not-into-api
forbidden.comment: The mobile app must talk to the backend over HTTP/WS only, never import its source. Share contracts through packages/types instead.

forbidden.name: api-not-into-client
forbidden.comment: The backend must never depend on a client application.

forbidden.name: shared-packages-stay-shared
forbidden.comment: packages/* are leaf libraries. A shared package importing an app inverts the dependency direction and makes the package unusable elsewhere.
